subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers adopt one of the conflicting fork PRs for this Feishu underscore-URL bug, close those fork candidates, or sponsor a fresh same-repository fix?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-proven, but there are existing open conflicting fork PRs plus a no-new-fix-pr label, so automation should not create another duplicate branch until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Queue or author one focused Feishu plugin PR that handles bare and embedded URLs with regression tests and live Feishu proof, then close conflicting source candidates as superseded.

options.title: Adopt one fork candidate
options.body: Pick the better fork PR, resolve conflicts, require focused tests and real Feishu behavior proof, and land it as the canonical fix.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Leave this issue open without new automation until one of the fork candidates becomes mergeable and provides proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Queue or author one focused Feishu plugin PR that handles bare and embedded URLs with regression tests and live Feishu proof, then close conflicting source candidates as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send/outbound ownership and release-line history make this the strongest available routing candidate for choosing the landing path.
